title: Paleo
subtitle: Cooperative Stone Age survival, exploration, tool crafting, and cave painting
tagline: Work together to paint your tribe's eternal story
loreSummary: In the untamed dawn of humanity, your tribe must band together to endure bitter cold, predatory beasts, and scarce sustenance. Explore varied environments, invent primitive tools, and complete the sacred mammoth cave painting before the harsh elements overwhelm you.
keyFeatures: Intuitive card-back exploration representing forests, mountains, and river valleys
Cooperative action sharing where players aid each other during simultaneous encounters
Modular scenario decks combining 10 distinct thematic modules into progressive challenges
Winner of the renowned Kennerspiel des Jahres 2021 award

paleo_full_chronicles.name: The Paleolithic Chronicles (Scenarios I–VII)
paleo_full_chronicles.description: The complete 7-scenario campaign progression from your first campfire to the climactic final cave painting.

paleo_introductory_tribe.name: First Steps of the Tribe (Scenarios I–III)
paleo_introductory_tribe.description: An approachable three-scenario arc covering early shelter, basic flintcraft, and the initial hunt.

paleo_master_survival.name: Master Stone Age Survival (All Scenarios & Variants)
paleo_master_survival.description: Comprehensive tribal odyssey including all base levels plus advanced custom module pairings.

milestones.title: First Steps
milestones.description: Gathering food and crafting basic hand axes while learning to read the backs of terrain cards without succumbing to wild perils.

milestones.title: A Safe Haven
milestones.description: Establishing a permanent shelter, domesticating fire, and preparing defenses against nocturnal predators.

milestones.title: The Deep Freeze
milestones.description: Harsh winter blizzards descend upon the valley, requiring warm hides, heavy fur crafting, and shared campfire warmth.

milestones.title: The Great Mammoth
milestones.description: Tribe members coordinate spears and traps to take down a legendary woolly mammoth, securing vital meat and tusks for the winter.

milestones.title: The Master Cave Painting
milestones.description: Completing the sacred five-piece cave mural to immortalize the tribe's triumphs and ensure their survival for future generations.
